DLC2316:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Falling snow paints the world white... Covering a girl's sorrow and her past...」

DLC2316:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place just after $$ノノ$$ awakened as $$バスターマシン７号$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ノノ$$ was a $$バスターマシン$$ herself... What effect did that have on the $$トップレス$$...?」

DLC2316:3:t_1:9.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$ - Hangar~

DLC2316:3:t_1:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「...I never imagined... you were a $$バスターマシン$$ yourself.」

DLC2316:3:t_1:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Embarrassing as it is to admit...」

DLC2316:3:t_1:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So the inspiration I felt when we first met wasn't wrong.」

DLC2316:3:t_1:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh, stop... You'll make me blush...!」

DLC2316:3:t_1:14.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Still, $$バスターマシン７号$$... Doesn't that make you older than $$ディスヌフ$$, the oldest surviving $$バスターマシン$$?」

DLC2316:3:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ herself has a fresh, youthful body!」

DLC2316:3:t_1:18.en:
$$チコ$$
「I was just thinking... We almost ended up with the oldest $$バスターマシン$$ piloting the newest one...」

DLC2316:3:t_1:19.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「By the newest $$バスターマシン$$, you mean your $$キャトフヴァンディス$$, $$チコ$$?」

DLC2316:3:t_1:20.en:
$$チコ$$
「Yeah... $$ノノ$$ and I were rivals for the right to pilot it.」

DLC2316:3:t_1:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah. When the $$トップレス$$ joined us, $$チコ$$ was already piloting $$キャトフヴァンディス$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_1:23.en:
$$チコ$$
「...This is a good opportunity. Maybe I'll tell you what happened.」

DLC2316:3:t_1:25.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's fine... It's all just a memory now...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The $$バスターマシン$$... It's in such terrible shape...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「...What do you want with my $$ソワサンシス$$, new girl?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Did you come to rub it in after I got shot down?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone else is still out on the mission, so $$ノノ$$'s supposed to take you to the doctor.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「A check for cosmic radiation sickness... I know it's mandatory for any pilot who gets shot down, but what a pain...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:14.en:
$$チコ$$
「So you heard me talking to myself...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:16.en:
$$チコ$$
「You... want to become a $$トップレス$$?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:18.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'm not interested in your story. ...But I'll tell you about the oath ceremony.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:19.en:
$$チコ$$
「Every year, the $$トップレス$$ with the highest score represents $$フラタニティ$$ at the $$宇宙軍$$ board's general assembly.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:20.en:
$$チコ$$
「And makes a big declaration about protecting peace with the power of the $$トップレス$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:23.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's so cool! A true hero of justice!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then why do you want to ruin the oath ceremony, $$チコ$$?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:26.en:
$$チコ$$
「If you heard that much, I might as well tell you...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:27.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$トップレス$$ aren't heroes of justice! We can't actually do anything!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:34.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do you mean $$ソワサンシス$$? Or the $$木星急行$$?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:35.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Both. ...For now, it's been decided that $$ソワサンシス$$ will be scrapped.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:36.en:
$$カシオ$$
「And thanks to the transfer, building any new $$バスターマシン$$s is all but impossible...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:37.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$チコ$$'s recklessness is nothing new, but she really outdid herself this time.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:38.en:
$$カシオ$$
「The main $$木星急行$$ attack is coming soon, and we've lost a major part of our fighting strength.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:39.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Though now that they come so close to Earth, it's strange we still call them that.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:41.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Don't worry, Mr. $$カシオ$$. There's a way to solve both problems.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:42.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Sure, if $$キャトフヴァンディス$$ starts moving...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:43.en:
$$ニコラ$$
（The twins on $$タイタン$$ intend to leave fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ to us... So the new model is our reward...?）

DLC2316:3:t_2:44.en:
$$カシオ$$
「A newly built $$バスターマシン$$ with no battle experience... Whether it awakens depends heavily on its initial pilot...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:45.en:
$$カシオ$$
「You know it, too, don't you? Half the $$バスターマシン$$s get scrapped without ever awakening...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:46.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Wouldn't it be perfect for testing her...?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:47.en:
$$カシオ$$
「You're going to put $$ノノ$$ in it?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The timing's perfect. With all the recent turmoil, we haven't been able to test whether she's a $$トップレス$$...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:49.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But if she can awaken a $$バスターマシン$$, there'll be no need for that.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:50.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That's true, but I don't think $$チコ$$ will take it quietly.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:51.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well... As far as I'm concerned, either of them can be the pilot.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:52.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just the Princess and me won't be enough to take on the $$木星急行$$'s main force.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:60.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Congratulations. I heard you tested negative for cosmic radiation sickness.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:61.en:
$$チコ$$
「Yeah. ...Were you waiting just to tell me that?」

DLC2316:3:t_2:62.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well, yes... Onee-sama and the others seem so busy that they don't have time for $$ノノ$$...」

DLC2316:3:t_2:64.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But that's not the only reason $$ノノ$$ came to see you! Because...!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:66.en:
$$チコ$$
「Sounds like $$ニコラ$$ told you about piloting the new $$バスターマシン$$.」

DLC2316:3:t_2:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「To suddenly be chosen as a $$バスターマシン$$ pilot... I'm moved! So deeply moved!」

DLC2316:3:t_2:68.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is one step closer to $$ノノリリ$$!」

review.context: Nono's Buster Machine identity prompts Tycho to recall their rivalry for Quatre-Vingt-Dix. The flashback establishes Soixante-Six's destruction and Tycho's hostility toward the oath ceremony.
decisions: Nono often names herself in the third person, retained where it is part of her excited voice.
The oath ceremony is the annual Topless pledge, not a wedding or military enlistment.
Princess is Nicola's nickname for Lal'C, left as an address rather than a literal rank.
